source: Derived from user-supplied Bing Webmaster Tools AI Page Stats and Grounding Query exports captured 2026-10-04; raw authenticated exports are intentionally not committed.
measurementBoundary: Citation counts are evidence of AI reuse, not traffic, ranking, conversion, revenue, or causal lift. Page Stats and Grounding Query exports are overlapping views and are not summed together.
clusterMethod: Derived topical classification of all 133 cited URLs using route/title heuristics for prioritization only; it is not a scientific taxonomy.

freshnessPolicy.rule: Citation demand signals may steer scheduling only while the dated snapshot is fresh. Missing, unparsable, future-dated, invalid, or expired signals fail closed to citation-neutral scheduling and never block unrelated scientific, safety, or governance work.

capacityPolicy.rule: Use citation-adjacent work as a strong ROI signal while preserving safety, scientific correctness, governance, blocker, and freshness gates. The target is a coordinator allocation goal, not permission to bypass the authoritative sprint/WIP system.

clusters.name: sleep
clusters.reason: Sleep remains the largest citation cluster, led by the 9,508-citation natural-sleep-aids page plus strong supplement, herb, valerian, magnesium, and glycine spokes.

clusters.name: stress-anxiety
clusters.reason: The stress winner reached 7,612 citations while anxiety-herb, kava, overthinking, adaptogen, nighttime-stress, passionflower, and rhodiola spokes remain broadly cited.

clusters.name: substance-use-emerging
clusters.reason: Mitragynine reached 3,059 citations with exceptionally low-share generic query headroom; 2C-B, 7-OH, pseudoindoxyl, and MGM-15 support a growing safety-first emerging-substance cluster.

clusters.name: adaptogens-nootropics
clusters.reason: Mushroom coffee and lion's mane continue to grow, with additional cognition/adaptogen spokes contributing citation breadth.

clusters.name: evidence-safety-trust
clusters.reason: Supplement quality reached 1,667 citations and remains a proven trust/methodology asset alongside evidence literacy and stacking-safety pages.

clusters.name: mental-health
clusters.reason: The antisocial personality disorder guide rose to 1,382 citations; diagnostic-intent demand is high, so accuracy and anti-self-diagnosis boundaries remain dominant.

clusters.name: adhd-focus
clusters.reason: ADHD/focus remains broad across many cited spokes; L-theanine-for-ADHD rose to 306 citations while the broad focus hub remains comparatively weak, favoring consolidation over page multiplication.

valerian.reason: Valerian-root article has 1,069 citations; the leading 'valerian root for sleep' grounding query has 599 citations at only 15.21% citation share.

valerian-root.reason: Direct high-citation page plus unusually high-headroom sleep query signal.

kava.reason: Kava article has 607 citations inside the strong stress/anxiety cluster; benefit/effect queries still have low-to-moderate citation share.

rhodiola.reason: Direct article signal plus adjacency to the 7,612-citation stress winner; scientific and safety gates remain dominant.

rhodiola-rosea.reason: Direct cited article signal plus stress/adaptogen adjacency.

lions-mane.reason: Lion's mane article reached 796 citations and remains a proven nootropic/adaptogen citation asset.

glycine.reason: Direct cited sleep-guide signal inside the dominant sleep cluster.

l-theanine.reason: L-theanine-for-ADHD reached 306 citations and multiple low-share L-theanine/ADHD query variants show headroom across ADHD/focus and sleep/stress contexts.

magnesium.reason: Multiple cited magnesium sleep and general-guide URLs remain strong, with low-share magnesium-form comparison queries showing additional headroom.

nmn.reason: Direct cited guide signal remains material but comparatively stable.

mitragynine.reason: Mitragynine reached 3,059 page citations; the generic 'mitragynine' query has 1,921 citations at 7.98% citation share and 'what is mitragynine' has 802 at 21.22%.

7-hydroxymitragynine.reason: Direct cited article signal plus strong adjacency to the mitragynine anchor; safety/provenance gates remain dominant.

mitragynine-pseudoindoxyl.reason: Pseudoindoxyl reached 267 direct citations and is a growing safety-first spoke beside mitragynine/7-OH; human evidence remains limited.

mgm-15.reason: Direct MGM-15 page now has 42 citations plus strong adjacency to the mitragynine/7-OH/pseudoindoxyl cluster; safety/provenance gates remain dominant.

tianeptine.reason: Substance-use hub adjacency; citation priority is exploratory and does not override safety or evidence gates.

corynoxine-b.reason: Emerging-substance adjacency with limited human evidence; citation priority is exploratory and safety/provenance gates remain dominant.

2c-b.reason: 2C-B article reached 701 citations and the '2cb drug effects' query has 365 citations at 24.22% share; safety/provenance gates remain dominant.

mushroom-coffee.reason: Mushroom coffee review reached 1,068 citations while the 'mushroom coffee benefits' query has 308 citations at 15.29% citation share.

antisocial-personality-disorder.reason: ASPD guide reached 1,382 citations with large diagnosis/DSM query demand; mental-health accuracy and anti-self-diagnosis boundaries remain dominant.

executionOrder: Protect and minimally perturb the dominant natural-sleep-aids, stress, mitragynine, supplement-quality, and sleep-supplement winner pages.

Exploit high-headroom existing intents without multiplying thin pages: generic mitragynine, valerian root for sleep, mushroom coffee benefits, 2C-B effects, natural sleep supplements, and herbs for anxiety.
Build the substance-use/dependence cluster around the 3,059-citation mitragynine anchor while preserving conservative safety, provenance, legality, and human-evidence boundaries.
Treat the fast-rising ASPD diagnostic cluster as a high-value mental-health asset with stronger-than-normal anti-self-diagnosis, source-quality, and clinical-boundary gates.
Audit overlapping sleep-supplement and duplicate-intent URLs before creating more adjacent pages.
Strengthen one canonical ADHD hub using the broad cited-spoke footprint rather than adding disconnected pages.
Add careful downstream conversion paths to commercial-adjacent trust/review winners only after the answer/evidence/safety boundary.
Replicate proven answer/evidence/safety structures to adjacent eligible pages and measure citation spread on the next fresh export.
guardrails: Never treat citation counts as revenue or traffic.
Never let citation priority bypass a hard scientific, safety, provenance, canonical-owner, review, accessibility, or release block.
Do not destructively rewrite high-citation passages without a migration/rollback reason and fresh measurement plan.
Keep at least 35 percent of discretionary discovery capacity for exploration so the system can discover new clusters.
Refresh this manifest from a fresh page-level export rather than carrying stale winner assumptions indefinitely.
Do not promote low-human-evidence psychoactive or opioid-adjacent pages merely because they are citation-adjacent.
Do not turn mental-health diagnostic query demand into self-diagnosis guidance; preserve clinician-evaluation and differential-diagnosis boundaries.
